entities.name: RlmN RNA methyltransferase
observations: Sequence closely matches reviewed bacterial RlmN homologs (64.0–64.7% identity; >93% query coverage); assignment is supported by homology, not direct experimental characterization of this query.
RlmN methylates adenine C2 in 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37; annotation indicates radical-SAM chemistry and a [4Fe-4S] cluster.

entities.name: RlmN RNA adenine methylation
observations: Adenosine at position 2503 in 23S rRNA or position 37 in tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine using S-adenosyl-L-methionine; reported reaction annotations also include reduced ferredoxin, 5′-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
